SOMA / ABOUT US

Planning software
for machine shops.

SOMA is three founders building SOMA Scheduler, production planning software for high-mix machine shops in Japan. We use AI agents in much of our work, which lets a small team build and support the product.

Meet the team ↓

01THE TEAM

The people
behind SOMA.

Steven runs the business, Federico leads the product and Luis builds the technology. We started with production planning because so many shops still plan on whiteboards and in Excel, and redo the plan every time something changes.

04FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

A little more
about SOMA.

Where is SOMA based?

For our company address or to arrange a conversation, please email hello@somakk.com.

What does SOMA build?

SOMA Scheduler helps precision manufacturers plan production. Teams can keep reusable part routings, schedule work around machines and working hours, and review changes while keeping the planner in control.

How can we speak with SOMA?

Email hello@somakk.com or use “Book a demo” below to suggest a time. We’ll confirm availability by email.
